description: User-controlled memory across conversations: save and recall preferences, knowledge, decisions, and work context.

interface.longDescription: XMemo saves and recalls your preferences, knowledge, decisions, and useful context across conversations and compatible AI agents. One Memory Steward skill handles general memory, chooses the right tools, and guides seven focused workflows: brainstorming, planning, plan review, progress auditing, session distillation, work resumption, and handoff. Personal memories need no project; writes follow your saving intent.
defaultPrompt: Remember this information for future conversations.
What did I previously save about this topic?
Bring me up to speed on my current project.

publication.release_notes: XMemo 1.0.2 strengthens Memory Steward as the single entrypoint for saving, recalling, applying, and managing memory, alongside seven focused workflow skills. Preserves the existing MCP endpoint and authenticated connection without ZIP auth overrides. No new server-side tools are introduced.
